project.description: Build and tag the pic-sure-mcp container image (standalone MCP server) from the shared "PIC-SURE Maven Build" reactor workspace. This job does not compile and does not deploy; deploy is exclusively via Stop/Start PIC-SURE. It succeeds without building when mcp.env is not configured or when the reactor has no pic-sure-mcp jar.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -e
MAVEN_WS="/var/jenkins_home/workspace/PIC-SURE Maven Build" CONFIG_DIR="/usr/local/docker-config/mcp"
if [ ! -f mcp.env ] && [ ! -f "$CONFIG_DIR/mcp.env" ]; then echo "MCP is not configured, so the pic-sure-mcp image was not built. Run 'Migrate PIC-SURE Environment' to enable it." exit 0 fi
if [ ! -f "$MAVEN_WS/build-info.txt" ]; then echo "ERROR: no reactor artifacts found. Run 'PIC-SURE Maven Build' first." exit 2 fi . "$MAVEN_WS/build-info.txt" if [ "${PIPELINE_BUILD_ID:-}" != "$pipeline_build_id" ]; then echo "ERROR: reactor artifacts belong to pipeline '${PIPELINE_BUILD_ID:-unknown}', expected '$pipeline_build_id'" exit 2 fi if ! ls "$MAVEN_WS"/services/pic-sure-mcp/target/pic-sure-mcp-*.jar >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "The reactor has no pic-sure-mcp jar because its pic-sure ref predates the MCP module. Skipping the pic-sure-mcp image." exit 0 fi
if [ -f mcp.env ]; then echo "A new mcp.env was loaded." mkdir -p "$CONFIG_DIR" cp mcp.env "$CONFIG_DIR/mcp.env" else echo "Using existing mcp.env" fi
docker build -t "hms-dbmi/pic-sure-mcp:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" \ "$MAVEN_WS/services/pic-sure-mcp/" docker tag "hms-dbmi/pic-sure-mcp:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" hms-dbmi/pic-sure-mcp:LATEST
